title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Industry-Wide Call to 'Pace the Frontier' Ignites Debate: Dario Amodei (Anthropic) published a landmark essay committing Anthropic to permanent 3rd-party safety evaluators and urging a slowdown on frontier training; Elon Musk endorsed the proposal while critics allege labs are protecting IPOs and cost structures against open-source models.

Google DeepMind Pretraining Gemini 4 & Rumored RSI Breakthroughs: Reports and insider rumors indicate Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 pretraining concluded ahead of schedule following breakthrough self-improvement techniques, prompting tech leaders like Sergey Brin and Demis Hassabis to shift focus entirely to AGI safety and alignment.

OpenAI Expands ChatGPT Sites to 5M Apps & Deprecates Legacy Codex: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Sites crossed 5 million deployments with new shared workspace co-editing and database inspection features, while engineer Tibo Sottiaux confirmed the retirement of legacy model GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark.

DeepSeek v4.1 Flash Rivals Top Models Locally: Open-weights benchmarkers report DeepSeek v4.1 Flash running locally on personal hardware matches or exceeds frontier models like Opus 5 and Fable 5.1 in frontend web design and reasoning tasks.

Diplomatic Push for Jimmy Lai & 9/11 25th Anniversary: Human rights advocates renewed urgent calls for the release of imprisoned publisher Jimmy Lai amidst health concerns, while international newsrooms marked the 25th anniversary of 9/11 with archival retrospectives.

items.title: @DarioAmodei & @elonmusk: Anthropic Proposes Frontier Slowdown as Musk & Altman Concur
items.body: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei issued 'We Must Pace the Frontier', committing to third-party alignment auditing. Elon Musk backed the call, triggering intense discussion on AI safety versus commercial motives.

items.title: @OfficialLoganK & @AndrewCurran_: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Finishes Pretraining Early
items.body: Reports circulate that Gemini 4 completed pretraining faster than anticipated due to novel recursive self-improvement (RSI) discoveries within Google DeepMind.

items.title: @ChatGPT & @thsottiaux: ChatGPT Sites Reaches 5M Apps; GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark Deprecated
items.body: OpenAI reported over 5 million web applications built on ChatGPT Sites, adding real-time co-editing and custom domain support while retiring the legacy Codex-Spark model line.

items.title: @MiaAI_lab & @yifanzhang_: DeepSeek v4.1 Flash & Recurrent Looped Transformers Emerge
items.body: Developers report DeepSeek v4.1 Flash performing on par with Fable 5.1 locally, while researchers introduced Recurrent Looped Transformers (RLT) for infinite reasoning depth.

items.title: @DrEliDavid & @nickmmark: Skeptics Question Frontier Pacing as IPO Protection
items.body: Industry analysts and researchers argue calls to slow AI development stem from plateauing LLM scaling and rising compute costs rather than existential risk alone.
